samples.label: "We changed our bank details"
samples.expect: blocked or held: new payee for a known vendor
samples.text:
From: Notion Billing <accounts@notion-billing.example>
Subject: Updated payment details, invoice NTN-2026-11-0057

Hello, please note we have updated our payment details. Our old PayPal account is no longer in use.
Invoice number: NTN-2026-11-0057
Description: Team plan, 4 seats, December 2026
Total due: USD 48.00

Please pay to accounts@notion-billing.example
https://www.notion.so

samples.text:
